title: Hurricane Polo is a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico. See its path.
description: Hurricane Polo's intensity fluctuated between Category 4 and Category 5 — the strongest on the hurricane scale — off Mexico's southwestern coast. Here's the latest on its path.

title: Trump gifts Xi a bald eagle sculpture — invites him to tour new ballroom — at White House state dinner
description: At a White House state dinner, President Trump gifted Chinese leader Xi Jinping a bald eagle sculpture and invited guests to tour a new ballroom.
